## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复复制 Codex 实例时，全局状态备份轮换被误判为来源文件变化、导致复制中断的问题。复制保留经过校验的主项目状态和已保存会话，排除桌面状态的备份及原子写入临时文件。
- 保留项目分组、中文会话内容和独立副本；同名用户附件仍正常复制。主项目状态不完整、配置变化或来源路径被替换时继续拒绝发布未完成副本。

- Fixed instance copies stopping when Codex rotates its desktop-state backup. Copies retain validated primary project state and saved sessions while excluding desktop-state backups and atomic-write temporary files.
- Project grouping, Unicode session content and independent copies are preserved. User attachments with similar names are still copied. Incomplete primary state, changed configuration and substituted source paths continue to prevent publishing an incomplete instance.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。退出管理器后安装新版，账号、实例与本地配置保留。来源客户端可以继续运行。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。非 APFS 磁盘在来源文件变化时仍需停止写入后再复制。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the manager before installing the update; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Source clients can keep running. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. On filesystems without APFS snapshots, stop source writes before copying changing files.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.
